# Assay

> Checks AI-written text against evidence. A set of separate checks (citations, quotes, figures, gate, grounding, values, links), each saying what it compared the text with. npm: @extrafemi-ai/assay. MIT.

- [What counts as evidence](https://assay.extrafemi.com/evidence/): what Assay counts as evidence, why, and which sources
- [Disclaimer](https://assay.extrafemi.com/disclaimer/): limits of Assay and this site
- [When AI made things up](https://assay.extrafemi.com/cases/): documented cases and whether Assay would have caught each
- [Get started](https://assay.extrafemi.com/start/): install and recipes
- [Reference](https://assay.extrafemi.com/checks/): every check, option and status
- [Self-healing](https://assay.extrafemi.com/self-healing/): how it avoids accusing when a source is down
- [Limits](https://assay.extrafemi.com/limits/): what it cannot do
- [Security](https://assay.extrafemi.com/security/): publishing, protections, link-checker threat model
- [Changelog](https://assay.extrafemi.com/changelog/)
- [Source](https://github.com/obasaolorunfemi-ai/assay)
- [Full text](https://assay.extrafemi.com/llms-full.txt)
